scoring_justification: The wave speeds constitute the structural outcome of the model; comparing against the paper's reference values with tolerance verifies faithful reproduction. Full recompute is infeasible because the intermediate porosity fractions needed for Eq. (53) are not given, so the checker cannot recompute speeds from scratch.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference wave speeds for the two-elastic-solid mixture and the porous medium (liquid He in glass) examples
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text in Section 3.1, numerical example results: for two solids the speeds are 5.94, 4.36, 4.92, 3.28 km/s; for the porous medium the speeds are 3.35, 0.55, 1.26, 2.92 km/s.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper sentences reporting the Mathematica calculation results
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values the paper states for its illustrative examples; they are the authoritative numbers the paper claims as its main numerical result.

outputs.description: Wave speeds in km/s for the two-elastic-solid mixture and the liquid-helium-in-glass porous medium. Each speed is accepted if |reported − gold| ≤ 0.05 km/s or relative difference ≤ 1 %.

output_contract.notes: The hidden verifier uses a tolerance‑based comparison (0.05 km/s absolute or 1 % relative) rather than bit‑exact matching. The target_policy is set to threshold_or_better to reflect this. The porosity_wave value for the porous medium is supplied directly (2.92 km/s) because its full derivation lies outside the Helmholtz decomposition used for the other speeds.
